level_1.title: Level 1: Outpost Sector
level_1.description: A compact 3-qubit Clifford payload. Establish a no-check baseline, then try your first detection strategy.

level_2.title: Level 2: Hazardous Corridor
level_2.description: A 4-qubit Clifford payload with more circuit depth. Compare which target-qubit sets improve fidelity without sacrificing too many shots.

level_3.title: Level 3: Deep Lattice Storm
level_3.description: A 5-qubit Clifford payload. Explore how different target combinations change the fidelity-retention trade-off.

level_4.title: Level 4: Thermal Decay Nexus
level_4.description: A 6-qubit Clifford payload with a deeper circuit. Check whether extra detection is worth the added circuit overhead.

level_5.title: Level 5: Clifford Core Meltdown
level_5.description: The largest campaign Clifford payload. Compare the full strategy space and identify maximum score, fidelity, and retention.
